header: These are the worked examples shown to the model. SEED_EXAMPLES are hand-written and are verified by the self-test (each must pass the guard AND run on the test database). CONFIRMED examples are real questions a person ticked as correct (public.nl2sql_log, verdict = 'confirm'); I add the most similar ones to every prompt -- that is how the system improves with use, with no code change.

symbols.name: pickExamples
symbols.sig: export function pickExamples(question: string, confirmed: Example[], k = 5): Example[]
doc: I choose up to `k` examples: always the best seeds (they teach the grammar) plus the most similar confirmed ones (they teach this database's usage).
